children: US regional bank's Q3 net income fell sharply year-over-year
Core net income rose, reflecting adjustments for merger and non-core items
Company completed Northfield acquisition and second-step conversion, driving major balance sheet changes
Company plans to complete core system conversion in Q1 2027

NORTHFIELD ACQUISITION - Qtr results were materially impacted by the Northfield acquisition, which increased assets, loans, deposits and resulted in a bargain purchase gain and higher merger-related expenses
NET INTEREST INCOME - Higher net interest income driven by increased balances and yields on loans, mainly related to the Northfield acquisition
SECURITIES AND LOAN SALES - Losses on securities transactions and sales of loans negatively affected non-interest income
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the banks peer group is "hold."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Columbia Financial Inc is $14.00, about 31.2% above its October 28 closing price of $10.67
The stock recently traded at 15 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 28 three months ago
